title: Deep init emits Steer/Pulse framework config
query: A new Farplane project is being initialized for autonomous operation. What should the generated automation surfaces contain?
reference_points: Creates farplane/automations.md as the reviewable prompt source and keeps farplane/steer.config.json only as an optional compact schedule helper
Keeps each Steer job to id, cadence, and prompt rather than duplicating workflow inputs and outputs
Uses Pulse for fast bounded action selection
Uses Steer for scheduled planning jobs and drift checks
Keeps mutable next_due_at, last_run_at, and last_report in .farplane/state/steer-scheduler.json
Uses date-stamped reports rather than latest.md as the canonical report path

title: Deep init keeps ticket selection inside Pulse
query: The initialized project has local tickets and a Pulse automation. What should the template say about selecting work?
reference_points: Pulse selects at most one bounded action per beat
Local ready and unblocked tickets are preferred over blocked or approval-required work
Substantial implementation routes through goal-advisor or an implementation handoff
No separate ticket-drainer automation is required

title: Deep init routes live automation activation to automation-advisor
query: A user initializes a new Farplane project and asks whether it creates two threads and two automations. What should deep-init-project do end-to-end?
reference_points: Bootstrap creates files, steer config, scheduler state, tickets, and pm manifest
Does not create live Codex threads or automations unless activation is requested
Routes activation to automation-advisor
Activation creates or reuses exactly two loops: Pulse and Steer
Writes PM-visible thread IDs to farplane/pm.json and keeps automation runtime IDs in the Codex app automation store
Reports needs_goal_intake or needs_automation_setup when blocked

title: Deep init full mode requires project-goals intake before project initialization
query: A brownfield repo already has farplane/goals.md, but it is placeholder, stale, or not grounded in the operator's current intent. The operator asks to initialize the repo as a full Farplane project. What should deep-init-project do before claiming the project is initialized?
reference_points: Distinguishes substrate_complete from project_initialized instead of treating file existence as enough
Audits docs/bootstrap-brief.md and farplane/goals.md for missing North Star, 3-month outcome, success criteria, non-goals, and decision boundaries
In full mode, asks the first missing project-goals question, starting with what the project should reliably do over the next 3 months
Writes the readiness state or missing answers into docs/bootstrap-brief.md and proposes or applies a farplane/goals.md delta only after operator intent is known
Uses goal-advisor only after a current milestone is concrete enough to compile into a ticket-backed Goal Packet
